## §3.1.1–3.1.2: The Principle of Inversion & The $2 \times 2$ Korporator {.smaller}

<div class="stratum-badge badge-d">STRATUM D: HISTORICAL EXEGESIS (SM, PP. 42–46, EQS. 10–11)</div>

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
### Breaking Monadic Isolation: *Prinzip der Inversion*
* Chapter 2 proved **Spaltbarkeit**: every history-dependent homogeneous Syntrix ($\homsyntrix$) factors into a chain of elementary pyramidal syntrices ($\overline{T}_{\mathrm{frag}} \circ \overline{T}_{\mathrm{pyr}}$).
* In §3.1 (SM, p. 42), Heim invokes the **Principle of Inversion**: nature must possess the exact inverse synthetic functor—the **Korporator**—combining autonomous Syntrices into entangled multi-modular architectures.

::: {.thm-box}
**Dual-Tier Action (*Duale Wirkung*, SM Eqs. 10–11):**
$$
\langle\langle f \widetilde{a} \rangle m \rangle \left\{ \begin{matrix} K_s & C_s \\ K_m & C_m \end{matrix} \right\} \langle\langle \varphi \widetilde{b} \rangle \mu \rangle,\; \overline{|CS_c|}_\gamma,\; \langle\langle G \widetilde{c} \rangle N \rangle \tag{SM-11}
$$

1. **Lower Tier (*Metrophorkorporation*):** Combines static carrier cores $\widetilde{a}_a, \widetilde{a}_b$ via **Koppelung ($K_m$)** ($p + q - \lambda$) or **Komposition ($C_m$)** ($p + q$).
2. **Upper Tier (*Synkolative Korporation*):** Combines dynamic generative modules via **Cross-Modulation ($K_s$)** or **Parallel Sum ($C_s$)** with arity $M_c = \Phi(m_a, m_b)$.
:::
:::

**Universalquantor Status (SM, p. 46):** Because a Korporator establishes an invariant structural relation ($\gamma$) between complete *Kategorien*, every valid Syntrixkorporation realizes a **Universalquantor ($\mathbf{U}$)**.
:::

::::

Chapter 3 solves the isolation of single Syntrices. If complex systems can be split into elementary parts (Spaltbarkeit), then by the Principle of Inversion, elementary systems can be wired together via the 2x2 Korporator matrix acting simultaneously on the static carrier tier and the dynamic module tier.
:::

## §3.1.3–3.1.4: *Eindeutigkeitssatz*, *Nullsyntrix* & Decompositions {.smaller}

<div class="stratum-badge badge-d">STRATUM D: UNAMBIGUITY &amp; BASIS DECOMPOSITIONS (SM-11a, 11b, 11c)</div>

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.thm-box}
**Heim's *Eindeutigkeitssatz* (Unambiguity Theorem, SM, p. 50):**
> *"Ein Korporator ist dann und nur dann eindeutig, wenn er mindestens eine synkolative und mindestens eine metrophorische Verknüpfungsregel enthält."*

A corporate operation is algebraically determinate iff it specifies at least one carrier rule ($K_m$ or $C_m$) **and** at least one module rule ($K_s$ or $C_s$).
:::

::: {.firewall-box .fragment}
**The *Nullsyntrix* ($\nullsyntrix$, SM Eq. 11a):**
$$
\widetilde{a} \{ \} \widetilde{b},\; \overline{||},\; \nullsyntrix \quad \lor \quad \nullsyntrix \equiv \langle \bar{f} \widetilde{c} \bar{m} \rangle \tag{SM-11a}
$$
Possesses an empty Synkolator $\bar{f}$ ($F_\gamma = \emptyset\;\forall \gamma \ge 1$), acting as the terminal boundary object closing deductive chains.
:::
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
<div class="video-container">
  <video data-autoplay loop muted playsinline src="media/Ch3_Act2_Eindeutigkeit_Decomp.mp4"></video>
  <div class="video-caption">Manim Act II: The Eindeutigkeitssatz, Nullsyntrix &amp; 4 Basis Gates</div>
</div>

::: {.carnap-box .fragment}
**First & Second Decomposition Theorems (SM Eqs. 11b, 11c):**
1. **Homogeneous Chain (SM-11b):** Every homogeneous syntrix decomposes via contractions $D_s$ into a finite corporate chain of pyramidal syntrices terminating in $\nullsyntrix$.
2. **Elementary Basis (SM-11c):** Every pyramidal syntrix decomposes into the **4 elementary structures**:
$$
\syntrix,\; \overline{||},\; \syntrix_{(1)} \{ \} \syntrix_{(2)} \{ \} \syntrix_{(3)} \{ \} \syntrix_{(4)} \tag{SM-11c}
$$
:::
:::

## §3.2.1–3.2.2: The Category $\mathbf{Syn}$ & Zero Object $0_{\mathbf{Syn}}$ {.smaller}

<div class="stratum-badge badge-a">STRATUM A: CATEGORICAL REALIZATION FUNCTOR &amp; SYNTRIX ALGEBRAS (DEFS. 3.1–3.3)</div>

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="52%"}
::: {.thm-box}
**Definition 3.2 & 3.3: Carrier Functor $\mathfrak{R}$ & Category $\mathbf{Syn}$**
The **Carrier Realization Functor** $\mathfrak{R} \colon \Ctx \to \FinBan$ maps $U \mapsto P^U$ and $\alpha \mapsto \alpha_P$.
An object in $\mathbf{Syn}$ is a quadruple $\mathcal{S} \coloneqq (U, \mathbf{F}, \theta, \iota)$ where:

* $\mathbf{F} = \{F_\gamma\}_{\gamma \ge 0} \in \operatorname{Obj}(\FinBan^{\mathbb{N}_0})$ is a graded sequence of finite-dimensional Banach spaces;
* $\iota \colon F_0 \xrightarrow{\sim} P^U$ is an isometric identification of the grade-$0$ syndrome with the context carrier;
* $\theta_{\vec{\gamma};\gamma} \colon \Osyn(\vec{\gamma};\gamma) \otpi \bigotimes F_{\gamma_i} \to F_\gamma$ are contractive operadic evaluations.

Morphisms $\Phi = (h, (\Phi_\gamma)_{\gamma\ge 0}) \colon \mathcal{S}_a \to \mathcal{S}_b$ intertwine $\iota$ and $\theta$:
$$
\iota_b \circ \Phi_0 = h_P \circ \iota_a, \qquad \Phi_\gamma \circ \theta_{\vec{\gamma};\gamma}^a = \theta_{\vec{\gamma};\gamma}^b \circ \big(\operatorname{id}_{\mathcal{O}} \otpi \bigotimes \Phi_{\gamma_i}\big)
$$
:::
:::

::: {.column width="48%"}
<div class="video-container">
  <video data-autoplay loop muted playsinline src="media/Ch3_Act3_Category_Syn_Zero.mp4"></video>
  <div class="video-caption">Manim Act III: Commutative Intertwining in $\mathbf{Syn}$ &amp; Zero Object $0_{\mathbf{Syn}}$</div>
</div>

::: {.carnap-box .fragment}
**Proposition 3.2: The Zero Object $0_{\mathbf{Syn}}$ (*Nullsyntrix*)**
$$
0_{\mathbf{Syn}} \;\coloneqq\; \big(0_{\mathbf{Ctx}},\, \{0\}_{\gamma \ge 0},\, 0,\, \operatorname{id}_{\{0\}}\big)
$$
is both **initial and terminal** in $\mathbf{Syn}$:
$$
\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf{Syn}}(0_{\mathbf{Syn}}, \mathcal{S}) = \{!\}, \qquad \operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf{Syn}}(\mathcal{S}, 0_{\mathbf{Syn}}) = \{!\}
$$
providing the exact categorical identity of Heim's *Nullsyntrix* ($\nullsyntrix$).
:::
:::
::::

## §3.2.3: Carrier Coproducts ($C_m$) vs. Span Pushouts ($K_m$) {.smaller}

<div class="stratum-badge badge-a">STRATUM A: GEOMETRY OF KONZENTER &amp; EXZENTER (DEF. 3.4, FIGS. 3.1–3.2)</div>

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="48%"}
::: {.carnap-box}
**Carnap 3.1: Intersubjective Constitution & OSR via Span Pushouts**
Following Carnap (*Aufbau* §§146–148) and Steven French's *Ontic Structural Realism* (2014), binding two $p$- and $q$-dimensional carriers across $\lambda$ shared channels is **not** a $(p \cdot q)$ tensor product, but a **categorical span pushout** in $\FinBan$:

1. **Composition ($C_m$ — *Konzenter*):** $\ell^1$-coproduct $P_a \oplus_1 P_b$ ($\dim = p + q$).
2. **Coupling ($K_m$ — *Exzenter*):** Given span $P_a \xleftarrow{\phi_a} R_\phi \xrightarrow{\phi_b} P_b$ with difference map $\delta_\phi(r) \coloneqq (\phi_a(r), -\phi_b(r))$:
$$
P_a \boxplusphi P_b \;\coloneqq\; \frac{P_a \oplus_1 P_b}{\Im(\delta_\phi)}, \qquad \dim(P_a \boxplusphi P_b) = p + q - \lambda_{\mathrm{eff}}
$$
where $\lambda_{\mathrm{eff}} \coloneqq \rank(\delta_\phi) = \dim R_\phi - \dim(\ker\phi_a \cap \ker\phi_b)$.
:::

## §3.2.4 & §3.3.1: *Konflektorknoten*, Module Lifts & Determinacy {.smaller}

<div class="stratum-badge badge-b">STRATUM A/B: GRADED MODULE LIFTS (PROP. 3.3) &amp; DETERMINACY (THM. 3.4)</div>

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.thm-box}
**Definition 3.5 & Proposition 3.3: Synkolative Module Lifts ($C_s, K_s$)**
1. **Parallel Composition Module ($C_s$):**
$$
\big(\mathbf{F}^{C_s}\big)_\gamma \coloneqq F_\gamma^a \oplus_1 F_\gamma^b, \qquad \theta^{C_s}(f \otimes \vec{u}) = \big(\theta^a(f \otimes \vec{x}),\, \theta^b(f \otimes \vec{y})\big)
$$
2. **Cross-Modulating Coupling Module ($K_s$):**
$$
\big(\mathbf{F}^{K_s}\big)_\gamma \coloneqq \bigoplus_{\alpha+\beta=\gamma}^{\ell^1} F_\alpha^a \otpi F_\beta^b, \qquad \theta^{K_s} \coloneqq (\theta^a \otpi \theta^b) \circ \tau_m \circ (\Delta_{\vec{\gamma};\gamma} \otpi \operatorname{id})
$$
* **Definition 3.6 (*Pseudovalenz*):** An $r$-ary functor with $n$ identical arguments has reduced **factual valency** $\operatorname{Val}_{\mathrm{fact}} = r - n + 1$.
:::

::: {.carnap-box .fragment}
**Theorem 3.4: 3-Level Corporate Construction Determinacy**
Given complete specification datum $\Sigma_r = (r, \Sigma_m, \Sigma_s, \Phi, \Gamma, \mathsf{Comp})$, the composite algebra $\Kor_{r, \Sigma_r}(\mathcal{S}_a, \mathcal{S}_b) = \mathcal{S}_c \in \operatorname{Obj}(\mathbf{Syn})$ is **uniquely determined up to unique isometric isomorphism**.
:::
:::

## §3.3.2: 4D Tesseract of the 15 Corporate Classes {.smaller}

<div class="stratum-badge badge-b">STRATUM B: COMBINATORIAL PARTITION (PROPS. 3.5 &amp; 3.6, FIG. 3.5)</div>

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="48%"}
::: {.thm-box}
**Propositions 3.5 & 3.6: The 9 Mixed vs. 6 Pure Partition**
The $2^4 - 1 = 15$ non-empty subsets $r \subseteq \{K_s, C_s, K_m, C_m\}$ partition by rank $\kappa = |r|$:

| Rank $\kappa$ | $\binom{4}{\kappa}$ | **Mixed (Determinate)** | **Pure (Underdetermined)** |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| $\kappa = 4$ | $1$ | **$1$** ($\{K_s, C_s, K_m, C_m\}$) | $0$ |
| $\kappa = 3$ | $4$ | **$4$** (All 4 Triads) | $0$ |
| $\kappa = 2$ | $6$ | **$4$** (Cross-Tier Pairs) | **$2$** ($\{K_m,C_m\}, \{K_s,C_s\}$) |
| $\kappa = 1$ | $4$ | $0$ | **$4$** (Singletons) |
| **Total** | **15** | **9 Mixed Classes** | **6 Pure Classes** |
:::

## §3.3.3–3.3.5: Syntropod Networks, Conflexivity & 21-Branch Fan-Out {.smaller}

<div class="stratum-badge badge-b">STRATUM B: COLIMIT TREES &amp; PRESENTATION CONFLEXIVITY INDEX (DEF. 3.12, FIG. 3.6)</div>

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="46%"}
::: {.thm-box}
**Definitions 3.10–3.12: Syntropoden & Conflexivity Index**
* The $i$-th **Syntropode** is the truncated graded submodule $\tau_{\le k_i - 1}(\mathcal{S}_i)$.
* Over a decorated corporate interaction tree $G_{\mathcal{S}} = (V, E_C \sqcup E_K, \Sigma)$ on $N$ Syntropoden with $\varepsilon = |E_K|$ Exzenter edges, deleting $E_K$ yields a Concentric Forest with:
$$
\operatorname{ConfIndex}_{\mathrm{pres}}(G_{\mathcal{S}}) \;\coloneqq\; k(V, E_C) \;=\; |E_K| + 1 \;=\; \varepsilon + 1
$$
and global colimit $\konflexiv \cong \varinjlim_{\mathsf{Tree}_{\Kor}(G_{\mathcal{S}})} D$.
:::

::: {.carnap-box .fragment}
**Theorem 3.11: Pseudoexcentric Branch Fan-Out**
Connecting $N \ge 2$ disjoint Metrophor origins via a *Pseudoexzenter* fans out into:
$$
N_{\mathrm{branches}} = N + \binom{N}{2} = \frac{1}{2}N(N+1)
$$
For $N = 6$, this yields $\frac{1}{2}(6)(7) = \mathbf{21}$ branches (matching the 21 symmetric potentials of the Hermetry matrix!).
:::
:::

## §3.3.6: Double Category $\mathbb{K}\mathbf{or}(\mathbf{Syn})$ & Mayer–Vietoris Emergence {.smaller}

<div class="stratum-badge badge-b">STRATUM B: HOMOLOGICAL FUSION EMERGENCE (DEF. 3.13 &amp; THM. 3.14)</div>

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="48%"}
::: {.thm-box}
**Definition 3.13 & Theorem 3.14: $\mathbb{K}\mathbf{or}(\mathbf{Syn})$ & Mayer–Vietoris**
* Horizontal 1-cells in the symmetric monoidal double category $\mathbb{K}\mathbf{or}(\mathbf{Syn})$ are corporate spans $\mathfrak{K} = (\mathcal{S}_\phi, \phi_a, \phi_b, \Sigma_r) \colon \mathcal{S}_a \nrightarrow \mathcal{S}_b$.
* Every Exzenter pushout induces a short exact sequence of chain complexes:
$$
0 \longrightarrow C_\bullet(\mathcal{S}_\phi) \xrightarrow{\;\delta_\phi\;} C_\bullet(\mathcal{S}_a) \oplus_1 C_\bullet(\mathcal{S}_b) \xrightarrow{\;\pi_{\boxplus}\;} C_\bullet(\mathcal{S}_c) \longrightarrow 0
$$
Passing to homology yields the **Syntrometric Mayer–Vietoris Long Exact Sequence**:
$$
\cdots \to H_{\gamma+1}(\mathcal{S}_a) \oplus H_{\gamma+1}(\mathcal{S}_b) \xrightarrow{\;\pi_*\;} H_{\gamma+1}(\mathcal{S}_c) \xrightarrow{\;\partial_*\;} H_\gamma(\mathcal{S}_\phi) \xrightarrow{\;\delta_{\phi *}\;} H_\gamma(\mathcal{S}_a) \oplus H_\gamma(\mathcal{S}_b) \to \cdots
$$
:::

::: {.carnap-box .fragment}
**Carnap 3.2: Humphreys Fusion Emergence Criterion**
Whenever $\ker(\delta_{\phi *}) \ne \{0\}$, the connecting homomorphism $\partial_*([z]) \in H_\gamma(\mathcal{S}_\phi)$ generates **emergent global homology cycles** in $H_{\gamma+1}(\mathcal{S}_c) \setminus \Im(\pi_*)$ that exist in neither Syntropode $\mathcal{S}_a$ nor $\mathcal{S}_b$ alone!
:::
:::

<!-- JAVASCRIPT FOR CHAPTER 3 INTERACTIVE LABORATORIES -->
<script>
function comb3(n, k) {
  if (k < 0 || k > n) return 0;
  if (k === 0 || k === n) return 1;
  let r = 1;
  for (let i = 1; i <= k; i++) r = r * (n - i + 1) / i;
  return Math.round(r);
}

function updatePushoutLab() {
  let p = parseInt(document.getElementById('po-p').value);
  let q = parseInt(document.getElementById('po-q').value);
  let lamInput = document.getElementById('po-lam');
  let maxLam = Math.min(p, q);
  lamInput.max = maxLam;
  let lam = parseInt(lamInput.value);
  if (lam > maxLam) { lam = maxLam; lamInput.value = lam; }

  document.getElementById('po-p-val').innerText = p;
  document.getElementById('po-q-val').innerText = q;
  document.getElementById('po-lam-val').innerText = lam;

  let dimCoprod = p + q;
  let dimPushout = p + q - lam;
  let zComb = p * lam * q;
  let ext2 = comb3(dimPushout, 2);

  let note = "";
  if (p === 6 && q === 6 && lam === 3) {
    note = `<br><span style="color:#FFD700;">★ STAGE III POLARIMETER MATCH: dim(P_c) = 9 ⇒ dim Λ²(ℝ⁹) = C(9,2) = <b>36</b> (Exact Ch. 9 Hermetry Capacity!)</span>`;
  } else if (lam === 0) {
    note = `<br><span style="color:#82aaff;">★ UNCOUPLED KONZENTER LIMIT (λ = 0): P_a ⊞₀ P_b ≅ P_a ⊕₁ P_b (dim = ${dimCoprod})</span>`;
  } else if (lam === p && p === q) {
    note = `<br><span style="color:#20B2AA;">★ FULL IDENTIFICATION LIMIT (λ = p = q): P_a ⊞_id P_a ≅ P_a (dim = ${p}, zero channel inflation)</span>`;
  }

  document.getElementById('po-lab-readout').innerHTML =
    `<b>Coproduct Dim (C_m):</b> p + q = ${dimCoprod}  |  <b>Span Pushout Dim (K_m):</b> p + q - λ_eff = <b style="color:#FFD700;">${dimPushout}</b><br>` +
    `<b>Coincidence Module F₁^c = Λ²(P_c):</b> C(${dimPushout}, 2) = <b style="color:#20B2AA;">${ext2}</b>  |  <b>Heim Combinatorial Count Z_comb = p·λ·q:</b> ${zComb}` +
    note;
}

function setPoPreset(p, q, lam) {
  document.getElementById('po-p').value = p;
  document.getElementById('po-q').value = q;
  document.getElementById('po-lam').max = Math.min(p, q);
  document.getElementById('po-lam').value = lam;
  updatePushoutLab();
}

let korState = { ks: true, cs: false, km: true, cm: false };

function toggleKorRule(key) {
  korState[key] = !korState[key];
  const labels = {
    ks: "K_s (Synk. Coupling)",
    cs: "C_s (Synk. Composition)",
    km: "K_m (Met. Pushout)",
    cm: "C_m (Met. Coproduct)"
  };
  let btn = document.getElementById('btn-' + key);
  if (korState[key]) {
    btn.style.background = (key === 'ks' || key === 'cs') ? "#20B2AA" : "#FFA500";
    btn.style.color = "#000";
    btn.style.fontWeight = "bold";
    btn.innerText = "✓ " + labels[key];
  } else {
    btn.style.background = "#1e293b";
    btn.style.color = "#FFD700";
    btn.style.fontWeight = "normal";
    btn.innerText = "✗ " + labels[key];
  }
  updateKorMatrixStatus();
}

function updateKorMatrixStatus() {
  let active = [];
  if (korState.ks) active.push("K_s");
  if (korState.cs) active.push("C_s");
  if (korState.km) active.push("K_m");
  if (korState.cm) active.push("C_m");

  let hasSynk = korState.ks || korState.cs;
  let hasMet = korState.km || korState.cm;
  let kappa = active.length;
  let box = document.getElementById('kor-matrix-status');

  if (kappa === 0) {
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#708090";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#cbd5e1;"><b>Vacuous Origin ∅ (κ = 0):</b> No corporate rules active.</span>`;
  } else if (hasSynk && hasMet) {
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#20B2AA";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#20B2AA;"><b>✓ MIXED DETERMINATE CLASS (1 of 9, Rank κ = ${kappa}):</b> r = {${active.join(", ")}}</span><br>` +
      `Satisfies Heim's <i>Eindeutigkeitssatz</i> (r ∩ Met ≠ ∅ ∧ r ∩ Synk ≠ ∅) ⇒ Unique composite Syntrix algebra S_c ∈ Obj(Syn)!`;
  } else {
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#DC143C";
    let missing = hasMet ? "Synkolative module tier (K_s, C_s)" : "Metrophoric carrier tier (K_m, C_m)";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#ff6b81;"><b>✗ PURE UNDERDETERMINED CLASS (1 of 6, Rank κ = ${kappa}):</b> r = {${active.join(", ")}}</span><br>` +
      `Violates <i>Eindeutigkeitssatz</i>: leaves the ${missing} underdetermined (*zweideutig*)!`;
  }
}

let treeEdgesEx = [true, false, true]; // Kor1=Ex, Kor2=Kz, Kor3=Ex
let surgeryMode = false;

function toggleTreeEdge(idx) {
  treeEdgesEx[idx] = !treeEdgesEx[idx];
  renderSyntropodTree();
}

function toggleForestSurgery() {
  surgeryMode = !surgeryMode;
  renderSyntropodTree();
}

function renderSyntropodTree() {
  const configs = [
    { nd: 'nd-kor1', tx: 'tx-kor1', l1: 'te-1a', l2: 'te-1b', name: 'Kor₁' },
    { nd: 'nd-kor2', tx: 'tx-kor2', l1: 'te-2a', l2: 'te-2b', name: 'Kor₂' },
    { nd: 'nd-kor3', tx: 'tx-kor3', l1: 'te-3a', l2: 'te-3b', name: 'Apex Kor₃' }
  ];
  let eps = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    let isEx = treeEdgesEx[i];
    if (isEx) eps++;
    let c = configs[i];
    let rect = document.getElementById(c.nd);
    let txt = document.getElementById(c.tx);
    let lineA = document.getElementById(c.l1);
    let lineB = document.getElementById(c.l2);

    if (isEx) {
      rect.setAttribute('stroke', '#FFA500');
      rect.setAttribute('fill', '#2d1a04');
      txt.setAttribute('fill', '#FFA500');
      txt.textContent = `${c.name}: Exzenter (K_m)`;
      lineA.setAttribute('stroke', '#FFA500');
      lineB.setAttribute('stroke', '#FFA500');
      lineA.setAttribute('opacity', surgeryMode ? '0.12' : '1.0');
      lineB.setAttribute('opacity', surgeryMode ? '0.12' : '1.0');
    } else {
      rect.setAttribute('stroke', '#4169E1');
      rect.setAttribute('fill', '#0f1b3d');
      txt.setAttribute('fill', '#82aaff');
      txt.textContent = `${c.name}: Konzenter (C_m)`;
      lineA.setAttribute('stroke', '#4169E1');
      lineB.setAttribute('stroke', '#4169E1');
      lineA.setAttribute('opacity', '1.0');
      lineB.setAttribute('opacity', '1.0');
    }
  }
  let kc = 3 - eps;
  let confIdx = eps + 1;
  let status = document.getElementById('tree-readout');
  status.innerHTML =
    `|E_K| = ε = <b>${eps}</b>, |E_C| = <b>${kc}</b>  ⇒  <b>ConfIndex_pres(G_S) = ε + 1 = ${confIdx}</b> (${confIdx}-gliedrig konflexiv)` +
    (surgeryMode ? ` <span style="color:#20B2AA;">[Forest Surgery Active: ${confIdx} Concentric Subtrees Isolated]</span>` : '');
}

function updateMayerVietoris() {
  let g = parseInt(document.getElementById('mv-glue').value);
  document.getElementById('mv-glue-val').innerText = g + '%';
  let t = g / 100.0;

  let yTop = 45 + t * 32.5;
  let yBot = 110 - t * 32.5;
  document.getElementById('mv-arc-top').setAttribute('d', `M 90,${yTop} Q 210,${-15 + t*25} 330,${yTop}`);
  document.getElementById('mv-arc-bot').setAttribute('d', `M 90,${yBot} Q 210,${170 - t*25} 330,${yBot}`);
  document.getElementById('mv-v0').setAttribute('cy', yTop);
  document.getElementById('mv-v1').setAttribute('cy', yTop);
  document.getElementById('mv-w0').setAttribute('cy', yBot);
  document.getElementById('mv-w1').setAttribute('cy', yBot);

  let cycTxt = document.getElementById('mv-cycle-txt');
  let box = document.getElementById('mv-readout');
  if (g >= 96) {
    cycTxt.setAttribute('opacity', '1');
    document.getElementById('mv-arc-top').setAttribute('stroke', '#FFD700');
    document.getElementById('mv-arc-bot').setAttribute('stroke', '#FFD700');
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#FFD700";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#FFD700;"><b>HOMOLOGICAL EMERGENCE (v_i = w_i):</b> H₁(S_c) ≅ ker(δ_{φ*}) ≅ ℝ[e_a - e_b] ≠ 0!</span>`;
  } else {
    cycTxt.setAttribute('opacity', '0');
    document.getElementById('mv-arc-top').setAttribute('stroke', '#4169E1');
    document.getElementById('mv-arc-bot').setAttribute('stroke', '#20B2AA');
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#20B2AA";
    box.innerHTML = `Uncoupled / Partial Gluing (${g}%): Boundaries separate ⇒ H₁(S_a) = 0, H₁(S_b) = 0`;
  }
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  updatePushoutLab();
  updateKorMatrixStatus();
  renderSyntropodTree();
  updateMayerVietoris();
});
</script>
